entities.name: Query protein 403 aa
observations: 403-aa sequence; predicted molecular mass 43.75 kDa and theoretical pI 7.69.
Strong homologs include bacterial CoaBC bifunctional enzymes (44–47% identity, near-full coverage) and a cysteine decarboxylase (55.1% identity, 87% query coverage).
Pfam matches: flavoprotein domain PF02441 at residues 5–182 and DFP domain PF04127 at residues 189–399.

Most plausible annotation is CoaBC: phosphopantothenate–cysteine ligase plus phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylase in CoA biosynthesis; reference annotations indicate FMN and Mg2+ cofactors. Exact function/substrate assignment remains homology-based.
